// TREND RESEARCH REPORT // 2026.09.28

1980s Photo Prompt 趋势调研

1980s AI Photo Prompt 趋势于 2026 年 9 月初从巴西 Instagram Stories 爆发，通过"Add Yours"贴纸病毒式传播至全球。Google Trends 显示搜索量 24 小时内增长 1,800%，周同比增长 5,000%+，每日搜索量达 20-50 万次。本报告汇总了从小红书、X 及公开渠道收集到的 prompt 文本、热度数据和传播路径。

调研日期：2026-09-28 平台：X · 小红书 · Instagram Prompt 收集：60+ 条

01 趋势概览

1980s AI Photo Prompt 是一种利用 ChatGPT / Gemini 的图片生成功能，将现代人像照片转换为 1980 年代风格复古照片的 AI 图片编辑趋势。用户上传一张清晰的人像照，通过 prompt 指定 AI 保留人物面部身份的同时，改变发型、服装、配饰和背景，并添加胶片颗粒、褪色、直闪等年代质感。

该趋势起源于 2026 年 9 月 4 日左右的巴西 Instagram Stories，通过 Instagram 的 "Add Yours" 贴纸机制进行病毒式扩散，随后传播至 X (Twitter)、TikTok 和其他社交平台[1]。截至目前，尚未找到可靠的原始创作者[1]。

传播时间线

  • 2026-09-04
    趋势在巴西 Instagram Stories 上开始出现，用户通过 "Add Yours" 贴纸生成 80 年代风格照片并邀请好友参与[1]。
  • 2026-09-06 ~ 09-07
    趋势从巴西传播至国际市场，进入印度、孟加拉国等南亚地区，Google Trends 搜索量开始飙升[1][8]。
  • 2026-09-08
    TALKAAJ 和多家媒体报道趋势 "going viral on Instagram and X"[2]。Snapost 报道称 X 和 Reddit 上出现大量 "before and after" 对比内容[3]。
  • 2026-09-09
    Indian Express、Bombay Times、Economic Times、Siasat 等印度主流媒体集中报道。Google Trends 显示印度搜索量 24 小时增长 1,800%，周同比增长 5,000%+[1]。多名印度 TV 明星（如 Dipika Kakar）在 Instagram 分享 AI 生成的复古照片[4]。
  • 2026-09-10 ~ 09-14
    趋势继续扩展，中文互联网出现相关讨论和标签（#AI生成 #80年代 #复古胶片 #chatgpt指令 #港风 #欧美）。多个 prompt 聚合网站（promptark.net、1980saiphoto.com、academy.techpresso.co）上线专门页面[5][6]。
  • 2026-09-28
    本报告调研日。趋势仍在持续，但增长曲线趋缓。核心 prompt 已形成稳定模板并在多个平台传播。

传播路径

巴西 Instagram Stories
↓ Add Yours 贴纸扩散
国际 Instagram + X (Twitter) + Reddit[2][3]
↓ 印度主流媒体报道 + 名人参与[4][9][10]
↓ Prompt 聚合站 + 中文社区 + 小红书标签
↓ 全球用户生成 (UGC) 持续扩散

02 平台调研结果

以下是对 X (Twitter)、小红书 和 Instagram 三个平台的调研结果。由于两个目标平台均设有登录墙，调研采用多渠道间接收集策略。

X (Twitter) 调研结果

X / Twitter 登录墙 间接证据

直接访问结果

通过浏览器直接访问 x.com/search?q=1980s+photo+prompt 时，页面被重定向至登录界面，弹出 "Log in to X" 对话框，要求邮箱/用户名或通过 Apple 登录。在未登录状态下无法查看任何搜索结果，因此无法获取帖子内容、互动数据及链接。

搜索引擎间接检索

通过 Google 搜索 site:x.com "1980s photo prompt" 和 site:twitter.com "1980s photo" 均返回零结果。X/Twitter 的内容未被搜索引擎索引，或索引后被 robots.txt 禁止抓取。

间接证据

  • TALKAAJ 文章明确写道："The 1980s AI photo trend is going viral on Instagram and X"[2]，确认 X 上有讨论
  • Snapost 报道："By September 9, 2026, social media platforms including X (formerly Twitter) and Reddit saw an influx of users sharing 'before and after' comparisons"[3]
  • The Run Time 报道："Instagram, X, and TikTok feeds are being swept by a wave of retro nostalgia"[7]

结论

未找到任何具体 X/Twitter 帖子 URL、作者用户名或互动数据（点赞、转发、浏览量）。仅能间接确认 X 上存在相关讨论。

小红书 调研结果

小红书 登录墙 标签线索

直接访问结果

通过浏览器访问 xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=1980s+photo+prompt 及多个中文关键词搜索，均弹出"登录后查看搜索结果"提示，要求小红书或微信扫码登录。在未登录状态下无法查看任何搜索结果。截图工具因页面保护机制返回"截图不可用"错误。

搜索引擎间接检索

通过 Google 搜索 site:xiaohongshu.com 1980s 和 小红书 "80年代" ChatGPT prompt 爆款 均未返回可访问的小红书帖子 URL。

间接证据

  • 头条搜索结果中出现相关标签：#AI生成 #80年代 #80s #复古胶片 #chatgpt #chatgpt指令 #港风 #欧美，表明中文社区有相关内容在传播[5]
  • 多个中文 prompt 聚合网站（promptark.net、1980saiphoto.com、pixshop.app）已上线中文版 1980s photo prompt 页面，说明中文用户群体已有需求[6]
  • pixshop.app 上出现了"柔光八零年代中国女孩一日分镜"和"80年代中国家庭看电视"等中文 prompt[11]

结论

未找到任何具体小红书帖子 URL、作者用户名或互动数据（点赞、收藏、评论数）。仅能通过间接标签和聚合网站确认中文社区存在相关内容。

传播机制

趋势主要通过 Instagram Stories 的 "Add Yours" 贴纸进行病毒式扩散：用户发布 AI 生成的 1980 年代照片作为 Story，并在上面添加 "Add Yours" 贴纸邀请 followers 生成自己的版本并标记回去[1][4]。

图 1 · 各国/地区搜索热度对比

印度以压倒性优势成为该趋势搜索量最高的国家，每日搜索量超过 50 万次。孟加拉国和印度次大陆其他国家紧随其后。沙特阿拉伯也有少量搜索。这说明该趋势在南亚市场具有最强的渗透力[1][8]。

值得注意的是，搜索量最高的并非 Delhi、Maharashtra、Karnataka 等一线城市所在邦，而是下沉市场地区，说明该趋势的传播不依赖技术早期采用者[1]。

与相似趋势的对比

The Creators Index 将此趋势与之前流行的 AI 图片趋势并列[1]：

  • Studio Ghibli 风格（2026 年春季）— 用户生成吉卜力风格肖像
  • AI 收藏手办（2026 年中）— 将照片转为 AI 生成手办
  • 1980s 照片（2026 年 9 月）— 当前趋势

04 收集到的 Prompt 合集

以下是从多个公开渠道收集到的 1980s Photo Prompt 文本，按类别分组。所有 prompt 均可直接复制到 ChatGPT / Gemini 等支持图片编辑的 AI 工具中使用，需同时上传一张清晰人像照片作为参考。

核心 Master Prompt

这是最广泛传播的标准 prompt，被 promptark.net、1980saiphoto.com 等多个聚合站作为主推模板[6]。

Master Prompt · 1985 经典影棚肖像
"Using my uploaded photo, show me what I would have looked like around 1985. Preserve my identity, facial features, skin tone, age, and recognizable appearance. Reimagine my hair, clothing, accessories, and surroundings with bold, unmistakably mid-1980s styling—expressive silhouettes, statement accessories, layered details, distinctive colors, and textures. Make it feel like a genuine 1985 photograph with analog grain, faded color, direct flash, and subtle softness. Add a period-accurate 1980s red-orange date stamp in the lower corner. No modern objects or text."

Bollywood 风格 Prompts

以下 prompts 来自 Siasat、JaanoJunction、Economic Times、Bombay Times 等印度媒体[9][10][4]。

Bollywood Heroine 肖像
"Transform my uploaded photo into a glamorous 1980s Bollywood heroine portrait. Keep my facial features, identity and natural skin tone recognisable. Give me voluminous softly curled hair, a colourful saree, statement earrings and classic 1980s Indian makeup. Add warm studio lighting, soft focus and subtle analogue film grain. Make it look like a genuine 1980s Bollywood publicity photograph, not a modern image with a filter."
Bollywood Hero 肖像
"Recreate this photo as an authentic 1980s Bollywood hero studio portrait. Keep my facial identity unchanged. Give me a period-appropriate hairstyle, a moustache if it suits the look, a classic tucked-in or slightly loose shirt and high-waisted trousers. Use a traditional studio backdrop, warm lighting, slightly faded colours and natural analogue film grain. Make it look like a genuine photograph from an Indian film shoot in the 1980s."
复古印度杂志封面
"Reimagine my photo as a stylish 1980s Indian magazine portrait. Keep my face natural and recognisable. Give me an elegant retro hairstyle, bold 1980s fashion, statement jewellery and sophisticated makeup. Use dramatic studio lighting, a simple vintage backdrop, soft focus and realistic analogue film grain. Make the photograph look like an authentic fashion editorial from the 1980s."
1980s 印度婚礼相册
"Imagine this photo was taken at an Indian wedding in the 1980s. Keep everyone's faces recognisable. Recreate the clothing, hairstyles, jewellery, decorations, background, lighting and photography style of an Indian wedding from that decade. Use realistic analogue film grain and natural colours, with the slightly imperfect look of an old family photograph. Do not make it overly faded or sepia."
Doordarshan 时代肖像
"Recreate this photo as though it was photographed for an Indian television programme during the 1980s. Keep my face and identity recognisable. Use authentic 1980s Indian clothing, hairstyle and styling. Keep the background simple, with warm lighting and subtle analogue film grain. Use realistic colours and make the photograph feel like it genuinely belongs to the Doordarshan era."
1987 印度街头照片
"Imagine this photo was taken on an Indian street in 1987. Keep my face and identity recognisable. Recreate the surroundings, clothes, hairstyle, vehicles, signs and colours to match late-1980s India. Use natural daylight, realistic colours and subtle analogue film grain. Remove modern objects and make the photograph feel as though someone genuinely captured it in 1987."

男性专属 Prompts

以下 prompts 来自 The Run Time 和 Media.io[7][12]。

经典影棚肖像 + 胡须
"Using the uploaded photo as the identity reference, recreate the person as a young man in the 1980s. Keep his facial features highly recognizable. Give him thick, voluminous 1980s dark hair, a neatly trimmed retro moustache, and authentic period styling. Dress him in a cream-colored collared shirt paired with a patterned knitted sweater vest. Place him inside a classic vintage photo studio with a muted painted backdrop. Use soft studio flash lighting, warm analogue film colors, subtle film grain, slightly faded print tones, and realistic skin texture. Ensure the final image looks like an authentic printed photo from the 1980s rather than a modern photo with a digital filter."
复古牛仔 + 经典汽车
"Using the uploaded photo as the identity reference, recreate the person as a stylish young man from the 1980s. Preserve his exact facial structure and identity. Give him naturally wavy, thick 1980s hair and a subtle moustache. Dress him in a vintage blue denim jacket over a plain white crew-neck shirt. Pose him casually leaning against a vintage 1980s car parked on an urban street. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, Kodachrome analogue film texture, soft contrast, subtle grain, and slightly worn paper edges."
正装绅士 / 办公室
"Recreate the uploaded photo as a formal 1980s gentleman portrait. Keep the subject's face fully recognizable. Style him with thick, side-parted hair with classic 1980s volume and a neatly groomed moustache. Dress him in a dark vintage suit jacket, crisp white shirt, and a wide striped tie. Set the scene inside an old-fashioned office featuring dark wooden paneling and retro office decor. Apply soft direct flash, warm beige and sepia undertones, subtle film grain, and realistic photographic imperfections."
80s 健身房肖像
"Using the uploaded photo as an identity reference, recreate the subject as an athletic young man in a 1980s gym environment. Preserve his recognizable facial identity. Style him with a full 1980s haircut and a trim moustache. Dress him in a vintage sleeveless athletic tank top and classic short athletic shorts, with a gym towel draped over one shoulder. Have him holding iron dumbbells. Set the background with vintage bodybuilding posters and classic weight machines. Use warm analogue tones, soft direct flash, realistic skin texture, and subtle dust specs on the image frame."
80s 摩托车英雄
"Transform the uploaded man into a stylish 1980s Indian cinema-inspired portrait beside a classic vintage motorcycle. Preserve his exact face, skin tone and recognizable identity. Give him thick textured 1980s hair, a bold patterned shirt with rolled sleeves, high-waisted faded jeans and vintage boots. Pose him casually outside an old Indian house or roadside setting. Use golden late-afternoon sunlight, analog grain, slightly faded warm colors and gentle halation."

通用 Prompts

以下 prompts 适用于任何性别和场景[7]。

通用 1980s 照片
"Transform this photograph into a realistic 1980s photograph while keeping my face, facial features and identity recognisable. Change my clothing, hairstyle and accessories to match the 1980s. Use period-appropriate styling, warm analogue lighting, subtle film grain, slightly faded colours and soft focus. Remove modern objects and make the image look like it was genuinely photographed in the 1980s rather than simply adding a vintage filter."
家庭相册快照
"Turn this photo into a candid 1980s family-album snapshot of the same person, keeping my face and identity fully recognizable. Add a slightly soft, slightly overexposed point-and-shoot camera look with warm colour casting, visible film grain, and a faint timestamp in the corner like old drugstore prints had. Give me period-appropriate 1980s clothing and hairstyle for a casual home or outdoor setting, not a studio."
大学年刊肖像
"Recreate my uploaded photo as an authentic 1980s college yearbook portrait. Keep my facial identity, expression and proportions unchanged. Style my hair and outfit in a typical late-80s college look, photographed against a plain gradient studio backdrop common in yearbook photography of that era, with even, slightly flat studio lighting and a faint vintage colour cast."
电影感复古肖像
"Reimagine this exact photo as a cinematic 1980s portrait. Preserve my face, facial structure and identity fully — no beautification, no altered features. Add moody warm-and-teal lighting reminiscent of 1980s film photography, a soft haze, subtle film grain, and period-accurate clothing and hairstyle. The background should feel like a real location from that decade, not a plain backdrop."
1980s 护照证件照
"Transform my uploaded photo into a formal 1980s-style passport or identification portrait. Keep my facial features and identity exactly recognizable. Give me an authentic hairstyle and formal clothing from the decade. Use a plain studio background, straightforward portrait composition, and soft frontal lighting. Make it look like a professionally developed analogue photograph from the 1980s, with subtle film grain, gentle color fading, and realistic photographic imperfections."
黑白 80s 影棚头像
"Using the uploaded photo as the identity reference, recreate the person as a studio headshot from the 1980s in black and white. Preserve the facial structure and natural expression. Style the hair with classic 1980s volume and texture. Use soft directional flash lighting, natural gray tonality, medium contrast, fine film grain, and subtle paper texture details."
旧相册发现的照片
"Transform my uploaded photo into a believable photograph from the 1980s that looks like it was discovered inside an old family album. Keep my identity and facial features recognizable. Change my clothing, hairstyle, and surroundings to reflect the decade. Add authentic analogue film grain, slight fading, soft focus, natural lighting, and small imperfections associated with old printed photographs. Do not make it look artificially filtered or digitally generated; make it feel like a genuine photograph captured decades ago."
80s 咖啡馆/餐厅抓拍
"Transform the uploaded photo into an authentic 1980s candid photograph taken inside a retro diner or cafe. Preserve the subject's exact facial identity. Dress them in mid-1980s casual attire. Place them seated at a booth with vintage interior decor in the background. Use warm ambient interior lighting combined with a gentle on-camera flash, analogue Kodachrome color tones, subtle lens flare, and film grain."
1980s 印度家庭合影
"Turn the uploaded people into an authentic Indian family album photograph from around 1985. Preserve every person's recognizable face, age relationship, skin tone and natural expression. Give them period-appropriate clothing and 1980s hairstyles. Arrange the family in a relaxed pose inside a modest living room or veranda. Use direct consumer-camera flash, slightly uneven exposure, warm faded colors, fine analog grain, mild softness and realistic aged photo-print texture."
80s 复古汽车肖像
"Reimagine the uploaded person as a fashionable young adult photographed beside a classic 1980s car. Preserve the exact facial identity and natural skin texture. Style the subject with voluminous period hair, a brown leather or patterned jacket, tucked shirt and high-waisted trousers. Pose them casually against the car on a sunlit Indian street with palm trees and period architecture. Use warm golden-hour light, 35mm film grain, faded color and soft contrast."

"Restyle [YOUR PHOTO] as a full synthwave portrait: a glowing neon grid floor, a setting-sun stripe pattern, and hot-pink and cyan rim lighting on me. Keep my exact face, likeness and identity unchanged: do not alter features, age, or skin tone. Vivid saturated palette, soft neon bloom, retro-futurist mood, subtle grain. Output as a 3:4 portrait."

中文 Prompts

以下为中文社区原创或翻译的 prompts[11][14]。

柔光八零年代中国女孩一日分镜
创作一个具有柔和80年代风格美学的高质量电影级分镜图，主角是一位20出头的年轻中国女性，图像中任何地方都没有文字。使用温暖的怀旧视觉语言，带有柔和的胶片颗粒、柔和色彩、金色阳光、微妙的霓虹灯点缀以及复古摄影风格。角色在各个场景中应穿着地道的80年代风格服装，例如高腰牛仔裤、牛仔夹克、超大号西装外套、波点或碎花连衣裙，以及复古运动鞋。场景从清晨到夜晚：清晨厨房泡茶、上午骑车穿过老街、午后唱片店翻唱片、傍晚天台看日落、夜晚霓虹街头漫步。每个场景都应体现80年代中国城市的怀旧氛围。
80年代中国家庭看电视
这是一幅温馨、写实的电影感室内场景，描绘了20世纪80年代一个中国四口之家在家中看电视的画面。房间简朴而充满怀旧气息，柔和的午后阳光从右侧一扇老旧的大木窗洒入。画面中共有4位家庭成员：父亲坐在左侧的藤椅上，身穿蓝色工装夹克和深色长裤；母亲坐在中右侧，身穿长袖碎花衬衫和简约长裤；年幼的女儿坐在沙发上。房间内有老旧的木制电视柜、搪瓷杯、挂历等80年代道具。使用暖色调胶片质感，轻微颗粒和褪色效果。

06 方法论与限制

调研限制说明

X (Twitter) 限制

  • X 平台要求用户登录后才能查看搜索结果，未登录状态下无法访问任何内容
  • Google 等搜索引擎未索引 X 的帖子内容（site:x.com 搜索返回零结果）
  • Nitter 等替代前端已不可用
  • 因此：未获取到任何 X 帖子 URL、作者用户名、点赞/转发/浏览量数据

小红书限制

  • 小红书强制要求登录（小红书或微信扫码）才能查看搜索结果
  • 页面保护机制阻止截图工具运行
  • Google 未索引小红书帖子内容
  • 因此：未获取到任何小红书帖子 URL、作者用户名、点赞/收藏/评论数据

Instagram 限制

  • Instagram 同样需要登录，但通过媒体报道发现了嵌入的帖子链接和作者账号
  • 嵌入页面的互动数据（点赞、评论）未公开显示
  • 因此：仅获取到 1 条帖子 URL 和 4 个账号名，无互动数据

调研方法

步骤 方法 结果
1 WebSearch 搜索 X/Twitter 帖子 零结果（site:x.com 无索引）
2 WebSearch 搜索小红书帖子 零结果（site:xiaohongshu.com 无索引）
3 浏览器直接访问 X 搜索页 被登录墙拦截
4 浏览器直接访问小红书搜索页 被登录墙拦截
5 WebSearch 搜索第三方报道/转载 找到多个印度媒体报道
6 WebFetch 抓取媒体文章内容 提取到大量 prompt 文本和趋势数据
7 WebFetch 抓取 prompt 聚合站 提取到完整 prompt 文本和图片资源
8 Explore Agent 综合调研 找到趋势起源、传播路径、Google Trends 数据

替代方案建议

如需获取 X 和小红书的具体帖子级数据，建议以下方案：

  • 提供登录会话：如果用户有 X 或小红书账号，可以授权登录后通过浏览器自动化访问搜索结果
  • 使用第三方 API 工具：如 Apify 的 X/Twitter Post Scraper 等工具可以抓取公开帖子和互动数据
  • 手动提供帖子链接：如果用户有特定的 X 或小红书帖子链接，可以直接 WebFetch 尝试抓取
  • 使用 Nitter 替代前端：虽然大多数 Nitter 实例已不可用，但可以尝试寻找仍在线的镜像站
